verdict.rationale: The only background behavior evidenced is opt-in alerting. Users can subscribe to text, push or email notices when their commercial registry records change or new filings are added, and to reminders for tax returns and annual reports. These run unattended once set up, but they only notify; they do not act on the user's behalf. Missing for 10: user-configurable automations that perform actions (e.g., scheduled or auto-submitted filings, auto-renewals), API or agent-driven workflow triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
